content:
Here is the recipe JSON:
{
  "recipe_name": "Chicken Butter Masala",
  "ingredients": [
    "1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs",
    "2 medium onions, diced",
    "2 cloves of garlic, minced",
    "1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger",
    "1 teaspoon ground cumin",
    "1 teaspoon ground coriander",
    "1/2 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper",
    "1/2 teaspoon salt",
    "1/4 teaspoon black pepper",
    "2 tablespoons butter",
    "2 tablespoons tomato puree",
    "1 cup chicken broth",
    "1/2 cup heavy cream",
    "2 tablespoons plain yogurt",
    "Fresh cilantro, chopped (for garnish)"
  ],
  "steps": [
    {
      "step_number": 1,
      "instruction": "Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the onions and cook until they are lightly browned, about 5 minutes.",
      "time": "5 minutes",
      "tip": "Use a non-stick pan to prevent the onions from sticking and burning."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 2,
      "instruction": "Add the garlic and ginger to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.",
      "time": "1 minute",
      "tip": "Be careful not to burn the garlic and ginger, as they can quickly become bitter."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 3,
      "instruction": "Add the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.",
      "time": "1 minute",
      "tip": "Use high-quality spices for the best flavor."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 4,
      "instruction": "Add the chicken to the saucepan and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.",
      "time": "5-7 minutes",
      "tip": "Make sure to cook the chicken to an internal temperature of 165\u00b0F to ensure food safety."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 5,
      "instruction": "Add the tomato puree, chicken broth, and heavy cream to the saucepan. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.",
      "time": "5 minutes",
      "tip": "Use low-sodium chicken broth to control the salt content of the dish."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 6,
      "instruction": "Reduce the heat to low and simmer the sauce for 10-15 minutes, or until it has thickened and the chicken is cooked through.",
      "time": "10-15 minutes",
      "tip": "Stir the sauce occasionally to prevent it from sticking to the bottom of the pan."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 7,
      "instruction": "Stir in the yogurt and the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter. Simmer the sauce for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the butter has melted and the sauce is smooth.",
      "time": "2-3 minutes",
      "tip": "Use high-quality yogurt for the best flavor and texture."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 8,
      "instruction": "Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over basmati rice or with naan bread.",
      "time": "2 minutes",
      "tip": "Use fresh cilantro for the best flavor and texture."
    }
  ]
}
how time will it take it to prepare

It will take approximately 30-40 minutes to prepare the Chicken Butter Masala. This includes 5 minutes to heat the butter and cook the onions, 1 minute to cook the garlic and ginger, 1 minute to cook the spices, 5-7 minutes to cook the chicken, 5 minutes to combine the sauce, 10-15 minutes to simmer the sauce, and 2-3 minutes to finish the dish.
